[[File:HunterSquadron-TERC.jpg|right|thumb|Hunter Squadron flies cover over Coruscant]]
'''Hunter Squadron''' was an ad hoc [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] formed by elements of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during their [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|infiltration]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. The group flew [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], and [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] served as [[Hunter Lead]]. They held off [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|interceptors]] while other Rogues brought down the [[Planet/Legends|world's]] [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]]. Its other members were [[Asyr Sei'lar]], [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]], [[Rhysati Ynr]], and [[Erisi Dlarit]]. Sabotage conducted by Dlarit&mdash;actually an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]]&mdash;led to Horn's fighter crashing and his [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisonment]] in [[Lusankya (prison)|Lusankya]].
